channel.name: Business Mafia

handles.note: Posting is done by hand by the operator from MafiaOfBusiness/output/<slug>/.

autonomy.authorized_by: operator, 2026-10-01, explicit instruction to build this pipeline
autonomy.scope: Producing one video per run into output/<slug>/ via scripts/run_episode.py. Does NOT authorize posting anywhere or skipping compliance-and-safety.md.
autonomy.known_risk: No automated visual QA step exists for generated scenes -- see SKILL.md.

channel.topic: How everyday Indian businesses make money and how the viewer could start one: '<X> वाला कितना कमाता है' deep dives and '₹X से शुरू करें ये N बिज़नेस' listicles, told as a Hindi story, never as a math lecture.

voice.model: edge-tts (Microsoft Edge online neural TTS, free, no API key)

settings.audio_profile: Confident adult male Hindi narrator, an insider telling you how the game really works. Emotion via per-section rate/volume/pitch (custom SSML is blocked server-side).

hook.note: The rupee shock or question. Slow, weighty.

duniya.note: The world: who this person is, what everyone thinks they earn.

khel.note: The money game: where it comes from, each cost with the owner's fix. Energetic.

raaz.note: The owner's smart move. Slower, admiring.

sabak.note: Rules for doing it well, a line of respect, comment question, next episode. Warm and calm.

voice.chunking_rule: 2-3 sentences per chunk, saved as 03_audio/chunk_0001.mp3 ..., stitched by scripts/stitch_audio.py.
voice.notes: Never change mid-video. Log any change in reports/changelog.md.

style_lock.image_prompt_suffix: hand-drawn black marker stickman on a clean white whiteboard, thick confident marker strokes, the stickman wears a black fedora with a gold band, a thin black outline suit jacket and a small solid gold tie, exactly two black dot eyes and NO mouth, calm neutral face, thin single-line stick limbs, no text, no letters, no numbers, one or two simple hand-drawn marker props only, money props drawn in gold, no arrows, lots of empty white space, only black, white and gold colors, no red, whiteboard explainer animation look
style_lock.negative_prompt: color photo, photorealistic, 3d render, shading, gradients, text, letters, numbers, watermark, mouth, red, extra colors
reference_assets: MafiaOfBusiness/brand/host/host-reference-clean.jpeg -- the boss stickman (variant 1 of 4, seed 11, approved 2026-10-01), sent with every scene request.
style_lock.generation_notes: FLUX.2 klein takes the reference image, which keeps the boss on-model. More than 2 distinct characters per shot collapses to 1; write multi-character beats as shot/reverse-shot. Indian settings (chai stall, dhaba, mandi, auto, wedding tent) are described as one or two simple props.

audio.pacing_note: Tighter than RedHat (0.55/1.0): a 4-minute video keeps momentum.

ambience.note: No music. Soft whoosh on every scene cut, a reveal sting on the first [RAAZ] beat, sparse money/food/market keyword cues (Devanagari stems, * = prefix).

transitions.note: Skipped on raaz beats, which get reveal_sting on the first one.

format.runtime_note: 8-12 minutes (2026-10-04, after the Growth Mitra analysis: their 2.5-9 min videos got 100-700 views, every hit is 16-27 min). stitch_audio.py and finalize_episode.py fail outside 480-720 s; check_script.py fails a script outside ~1,100-1,700 words. Fix by editing the script, never by changing the voice speed.
format.words_per_minute_note: Measured 2026-10-01: hi-IN-MadhurNeural at default rate speaks ~140 Hindi words/min. Budget ~1,250-1,500 words for 600 s.
format.animation_stage_note: Ken Burns push in/out per scene via ffmpeg zoompan; direction from shotlist 'motion', else alternating.
format.no_intro_outro: No intro sting or outro card. The hook beat is the first scene.

episode_formats.kamai: Deep dive: '<X> वाला कितना कमाता है?' -- one business, one character (रमेश), the full hisaab, and a 'आप शुरू करना चाहें तो' block in [SABAK].
episode_formats.list: Listicle: '₹<X> से शुरू करें ये <N> बिज़नेस' -- five to seven businesses the viewer can start with that budget, each with what the money buys, a realistic monthly range and one beginner mistake with its fix.
episode_formats.rule: Alternate the two formats; topic.json carries format: kamai | list (script-formula.md, topic-strategy.md).

captions.title: Mafia of Business animated captions
captions.font_family_note: Installed at /usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/; libass + HarfBuzz shape conjuncts and matras.

thumbnail.note: Two-band title (white on black, black on yellow) on the left with rupee figures and digits highlighted (yellow on black, green on yellow), the thumbnail scene on the right, a green growth arrow top right, an optional green rupee badge. Brighter after the Growth Mitra analysis (2026-10-04); the in-video palette stays black/white/gold.

baselines.baselines_note: Filled by the operator from YouTube Studio; never invented by the agent.
